progressiveDisclosure: Framework route, transaction, owner, provider, and evidence

prompt.primaryRequest: Create an original shippable visual concept called Topology Observatory: an interactive observatory for deterministic information flows rather than a generic developer-docs template.
prompt.composition: One dominant desktop Landing frame with legible mobile, documentation, and Runtime Atlas insets on a deep graphite coordinate plane.
prompt.narrative: INFORMATION, EXECUTED. with working-product and Framework-learning entrances.
prompt.semantics: UI intent to App Feature and API, then an orange transaction boundary around Factory and canonical owners, followed by UI projection; Preset and Provider remain dashed optional composition; future runtime is outside the active route.
prompt.constraints: CSS-feasible geometry, accessible contrast, visible focus, readable mobile and documentation states, no external assets, no generic card grid, no glassmorphism, no unsupported Core Kernel claim.

strengths: strong Runtime Atlas and engineering-depth language
clear current, optional, transaction, accepted, and roadmap marks
credible dark shell plus warm reading surface
risks: above-the-fold narrative expects more technical literacy than the global audience contract permits
dense topology should appear after the plain-language value layer

prompt.primaryRequest: Create an original shippable visual concept called Material Blueprint that lets a worldwide non-engineer understand Asyra before progressively revealing the technical Framework.
prompt.composition: A global editorial Landing sheet with warm mineral paper, architectural registration marks, one continuous world-building fold, and mobile, documentation, and Runtime Atlas insets.
prompt.narrative: BUILD THE TOOL YOUR WORLD NEEDS. You define the knowledge. Asyra keeps every action clear, safe, and reversible. Whiteboard, BIM, and simulation remain App-owned examples.
prompt.semantics: DESCRIBE to ACT to VERIFY, then Feature to API to transaction-bounded owners to projection; indigo canonical route, violet optional route, vermilion transaction, green accepted state, cross-hatched verified roadmap boundary.
prompt.constraints: Plain international English first, localized-text resilience, 44px touch intent, long-form reading, shapes plus color, no external assets, no SaaS card grid, no invented roadmap items.

strengths: concrete possibilities remain explicitly App-owned examples
strong mobile and long-form reading hierarchy
technical depth arrives through progressive disclosure
warm material identity is distinctive yet implementable
risks: illustrated possibility panorama must be rebuilt as code-native line work rather than shipped as raster
technical blue annotation density must be reduced at narrow widths

prompt.primaryRequest: Create an original shippable visual concept called Signal Ledger: a living ledger where knowledge becomes controlled, observable action.
prompt.composition: A bold narrative column beside a continuous event ledger, with mobile, long-form documentation, and active/failure Runtime Atlas insets.
prompt.narrative: FROM KNOWLEDGE TO ACTION. You bring the domain. Asyra brings the structure for safe, reversible action. Name what matters, define what can happen, and see every outcome.
prompt.semantics: Idea, action, check, and result precede expandable Feature, API, transaction, owner, projection, and evidence details; accepted, optional, failure, and roadmap states use shape and text as well as color.
prompt.constraints: Plain international English, localization resilience, 44px touch intent, light reading surface, no external assets, no generic dashboard or card grid, current examples separated from roadmap.

strengths: best active, optional, failure, and roadmap state differentiation
plain and technical evidence views coexist
strong source for Runtime Atlas timeline and motion
risks: ledger density can overload the Landing page
large condensed type and technical rows require careful localization behavior

selectionRationale.primary: Material Blueprint gives a worldwide non-engineer the clearest first explanation of Asyra through outcomes, creator ownership, and concrete product possibilities before it introduces Framework mechanics.
absorbedLanguage: Topology Observatory coordinate and route language for Runtime Atlas depth
Signal Ledger state, failure, evidence, and timeline language
selectionRationale.implementationRule: Generated raster boards are inspected visual evidence only; production visuals must be recreated with repository-owned HTML, CSS, SVG, Canvas, and runtime data.

prompt.purpose: Resolve the Material Blueprint Landing page at desktop and 390px mobile widths.
prompt.requiredEvidence: Plain-language value first, creator-owned product possibilities, Describe-Act-Verify progressive disclosure, two beginner entrances, and a technical route revealed only after the value story.

findings: Desktop and mobile preserve one narrative order.
A non-engineer can understand the outcome before seeing package or transaction language.
Create Asyra Design App and Learn the Framework are distinct, compatible beginner entrances.

prompt.purpose: Resolve long-form documentation at desktop, open mobile navigation, and mobile reading states.
prompt.requiredEvidence: Persistent hierarchy without generic dashboard cards, readable measure, visible focus, release facts verified from manifests, and the repository support policy exposed without inventing community claims.

findings: Desktop reading, mobile navigation, and mobile content are separately legible.
The navigation sheet has a clear close affordance and returns to reading.
Release and support language stays tied to project-owned sources.

prompt.purpose: Resolve Runtime Atlas default, active transaction, accepted evidence, and failure states.
prompt.requiredEvidence: Intent-to-feature route, transaction owner, canonical Scene and Props owners, optional Preset and Provider composition, projection, evidence ledger, and an explicit no-canonical-change failure result.

findings: Default, active, accepted, and failure states are distinguishable through shape, label, and color.
The active selector runs one transaction rather than implying a product-specific preset.
Failure visibly reverses the route and preserves canonical state.

prompt.purpose: Resolve Asyra Design as a reference product and separate current Framework capability, App-owned possibilities, and verified roadmap boundaries.
prompt.requiredEvidence: A real product path from creator intent to result, domain knowledge owned by the app, current capability marked with an indigo bar, app possibilities with outline circles, and roadmap with crosshatching.

findings: Asyra Design is clearly a reference product rather than the Framework boundary.
Whiteboard, BIM, and simulation remain App-owned possibilities.
Current, possible, accepted, and roadmap meanings do not collapse into one status.

prompt.purpose: Resolve motion, interruption, focus, semantic timing, and reduced-motion equivalence across Landing, Docs, and Runtime Atlas.
prompt.requiredEvidence: Five observable Atlas frames, pre-commit cancellation, post-commit persistence, focus continuity, entry-only Landing reveal, mobile navigation sheet behavior, and simultaneous reduced-motion state replacement.

findings: Factory is the transaction owner while Scene and Props remain canonical owners.
Content, order, focus, status, and evidence are identical in the reduced-motion equivalent.
Motion is bounded to 480ms and never uses autoplay, parallax, or scroll hijacking.

imageTextDeviations.resolution: The implementation handoff and production copy use the authoritative text. The raster is layout and state evidence, never content authority.
